quarterly_data.quarter: Frencken Group half-year results: Condensed Interim Financial Statements for the Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2Q26: group revenue S$225.8 million, up 4.7% year-on-year and 11.7% quarter-on-quarter; semiconductor segment revenue up 4.6% to S$114.5 million, with Mechatronics Asia recording robust double-digit semiconductor sales growth and Mechatronics Europe improving quarter-on-quarter. 1H26 revenue S$427.8 million (1H25 S$431.4 million); semiconductor was 49.9% of 1H26 revenue; gross margin widened to 15.0% from 14.1%; 2Q26 PATMI S$11.3 million, up 13.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q26 revenue S$225.8 million (+4.7% YoY); semiconductor S$114.5 million (+4.6%); 1H26 revenue S$427.8 million; semiconductor 49.9% of revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Frencken Group half-year results: Condensed Interim Financial Statements for the Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: total revenue for 2H26 is envisaged to be higher than 2H25 and 1H26, and revenue and profit for FY2026 are expected to be higher than FY2025, barring adverse external changes and FX volatility. Based on its core businesses' trajectory the group envisages it could cross the S$1 billion annual revenue mark by 2028 if not earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue and profit higher than FY2025; S$1 billion revenue by 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Frencken Group half-year results: Condensed Interim Financial Statements for the Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor customers: Mechatronics Asia's growth was buoyed by robust order inflows from key front-end and back-end semiconductor equipment customers and is expected to continue in 2H26 as demand from a major front-end equipment OEM remains solid for certain programs in volume production, with multiple First Articles and new projects. Mechatronics Europe is positioned for an anticipated ramp for a major front-end semiconductor equipment customer in 2H26; this European OEM (not named) recently gave an upbeat outlook in line with its customers' accelerated capacity expansion. Revenue from the group's 3 largest customers was approximately $176,973,000 of Mechatronics revenue in 1H26 (1H25 $207,176,000).

quarterly_data.quarter: Frencken Group half-year results: Condensed Interim Financial Statements for the Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: a new facility in Singapore is scheduled to be operationally ready by 2H27 to address the production needs of key semiconductor and aerospace customers; the group plans to review its Malaysia mechatronics capacity. Inventories rose to S$236.4 million at 30 June 2026 from S$198.5 million for fulfilment of customers' orders. Frencken expects the semiconductor equipment upcycle to stretch through at least 2027 and possibly 2028 and is aligning capacity to key customers' roadmaps.
quarterly_data.figure: Singapore facility ready 2H27; inventories S$236.4 million
